$comment: Movement classes (ruleset v0): how each class meets the ground and water. Cost of a cell = (baseCost + slopeCost * slope / 1000) * 1000 / speed, slope in permille (rise over run, 1000 = 45 degrees), speed in permille = water speed by depth (mm) x mud speed by mud (0-65535); steeper than maxSlopePermille is impassable, and so is water deeper than maxEnterDepthMm or water that sweeps the class (at least sweptDepthMm deep, or at least sweptMinDepthMm deep with depth x flow speed (mm x mm/s / 1000) at least sweptDepthSpeed). Slope numbers are placeholders for spec pass S2; the water and mud numbers are spec S1, section 3 and 6 (settled 2026-11-03). Field-driven costs refresh every fieldCostRefreshTicks (20 = 1 Hz). The water class's water response is inert; the class itself stays impassable until boats exist.
